y-m-45-06.title: Gwaji da saitin lambobi guda ɗaya hujja ce?
y-m-45-06.topic: Yadda ake zaɓar haɗin ma’aunai da gama-gari yayin tabbatar da sifar ta hanyar ma’aunai
y-m-45-06.goal: Yayin tabbatar da sifar ta amfani da ma’aunai, fayyace irin zaɓen haɗin da ke wakiltar kowace alwatika, sannan ka bayyana wa aboki dalilin da ya sa amfani da siffa ta musamman guda ba hujja ba ne.
y-m-45-06.material: Bari M da N su zama tsakiyar ɓangarorin AB da AC na alwatika ABC. Ana so a tabbatar da ma’aunai cewa MN yana layi ɗaya da BC, tsawonsa kuma rabin BC ne. (√3 ana karantawa “tushen 3”.) Zaɓen haɗin yana da muhimmanci.
y-m-45-06.thinking.0: Zaɓar haɗin ma’aunai da ba ya rage gama-gari.
y-m-45-06.thinking.1: Nemo kuskuren faɗaɗa hukunci a cikin warwarewa.
y-m-45-06.thinking.2: Gyara bayani, ka bayyana wa aboki da kalmomi masu dacewa.
y-m-45-06.prereq.1: Tsakiya, gangare da nisa tsakanin maki biyu.
y-m-45-06.prereq.2: Sifar sashen da ke haɗa tsakiyar ɓangarorin biyu na alwatika (sanannen sakamakon matakin sakandare ƙasa).
y-m-45-06.s.s1.prompt: Ana son tabbatar da wannan “ga kowace alwatika ABC”. Zaɓi duk zaɓen haɗin da ke iya wakiltar kowace alwatika ba tare da rage gama-gari ba. (a, b, c haruffa ne da ba sa takaita siffa, kamar ƙimomin tabbatattu.)
y-m-45-06.s.s1.hint.0: Ga kowace zaɓi, yi tunanin irin alwatikan da za ka iya samarwa idan ka canza haɗin kololuwar (haruffa ko lambobi).
y-m-45-06.s.s1.hint.1: Ta zaɓen haɗin iri ɗaya, gwada ko za ka iya ƙirƙirar alwatika mai kusurwar dama, daidai-gefe, da kowace siffa.
y-m-45-06.s.s1.o.a: A(0, 0), B(4, 0), C(0, 3) (duk haɗin lambobi ne).
y-m-45-06.s.s1.r.a: An kayyade da lambobi, saboda haka alwatika mai kusurwar dama guda ɗaya kawai ake wakilta.
y-m-45-06.s.s1.r.b: Idan an sa gefe guda a axis x, kololuwa ɗaya kuma a asali, kololuwar da ta rage tana da ’yanci, don haka kowace alwatika za a iya wakilta.
y-m-45-06.s.s1.r.c: An kayyade haɗin x na A da 0, saboda haka alwatika ce mai kusurwar dama a B kawai.
y-m-45-06.s.s1.o.d: A(0, 0), B(2, 0), C(1, √3) (duk haɗin an kayyade su).
y-m-45-06.s.s1.r.d: Yana nuna alwatika mai daidai-gefe guda ɗaya, kowane gefe 2.
y-m-45-06.s.s1.r.e: Wannan hanya ce ta sa tsakiyar BC a asali. A yana da ’yanci, don haka kowace alwatika za a iya wakilta.
y-m-45-06.s.s1.r.f: Yana sa A a kan bisector mai tsaye na BC, saboda haka alwatika mai cinyoyi daidai ce kawai.
y-m-45-06.s.s1.explain: Ana iya matsar da alwatika a juya ta domin sa gefe guda a axis x (a juya ta idan ya zama dole domin A ya kasance sama da axis x), kololuwa ɗaya kuma a asali; ko a sa tsakiyar gefen a asali. Tsawo da dangantakar layi ɗaya ba sa canzawa idan an matsar, saboda haka b da e suna wakiltar kowace alwatika. a, c, d, f kuma suna nuna siffofi da aka kayyade tuni, kamar alwatika mai kusurwar dama, daidai-gefe ko mai cinyoyi daidai.
y-m-45-06.s.s2.prompt: Wani ɗalibi ya sa A(0, 0), B(4, 0), C(0, 3), ya rubuta kamar haka. Zaɓi layin da matsala ce ga hujja. (Zaɓin layi guda ya isa.)
y-m-45-06.s.s2.hint.0: Sake lissafta lissafin layuka 2 zuwa 4 ɗaya bayan ɗaya don ganin ko sun dace ga wannan alwatika.
y-m-45-06.s.s2.hint.1: Kwatanta irin alwatikan da haɗin layi na 1 zai iya wakilta da iyakar da layi na 5 yake magana a kai.
y-m-45-06.s.s2.line.0: Sanya kololuwar ABC a A(0, 0), B(4, 0), C(0, 3).
y-m-45-06.s.s2.line.1: Tsakar AB, M, ita ce (2, 0), tsakar AC, N, kuma (0, 3/2).
y-m-45-06.s.s2.line.2: Gangaren MN ita ce (3/2−0)/(0−2)=−3/4, gangaren BC kuma (3−0)/(0−4)=−3/4, saboda haka MN da BC layuka ne masu layi ɗaya.
y-m-45-06.s.s2.line.3: MN=√(2²+(3/2)²)=5/2, BC=√(4²+3²)=5, don haka MN rabin BC ne.
y-m-45-06.s.s2.line.4: Saboda haka a kowace alwatika, sashen da ya haɗa tsakiyar ɓangarori biyu yana layi ɗaya da gefen da ya rage, tsawonsa kuma rabin shi ne.
y-m-45-06.s.s2.explain: Layi na 1 da na 5 ne matsala. Lissafin layuka 2 zuwa 4 duka daidai ne, amma layi na 1 ya kayyade haɗin alwatika guda mai kusurwar dama, saboda haka ba za a iya ci gaba zuwa “kowace alwatika” a layi na 5 ba. Alwatika guda ɗaya ce kawai aka gwada.
y-m-45-06.s.s3.prompt: Ka bayyana wa abokin da ya rubuta wannan mafita dalilin da ya sa ba hujja ba ce ga kowace alwatika, sannan rubuta jimla 2 ko 3 yadda za a gyara. Yi amfani da kalmomi masu sauƙin fahimta.
y-m-45-06.s.s3.hint.0: Ka yi kamar kana yi wa abokinka bayani, da farko ka faɗi irin alwatikan da mafitar ta yi amfani da ita.

y-m-45-08.title: Idan an canza tsarin motsi, sakamakon iri ɗaya ne?
y-m-45-08.topic: Tsarin hada matsarwa da nuna a madubi.
y-m-45-08.goal: Nemo kuskure a warwarewar matsar layi, sannan nemo da fayyace sharadin da ke sa sauya tsarin matsarwa da nuna a madubi bisa y=x ya ba da sakamako ɗaya.
y-m-45-08.material: Ana son matsar layin m: y=2x+1 sau biyu. Motsi ㉠ matsarwa ce ta 3 zuwa hanyar x (maki 3 zuwa dama), ㉡ kuma nuna a madubi bisa layin y=x. 지후 ya yi ㉠ da farko sannan ㉡.
y-m-45-08.thinking.1: Ƙirƙiri yanayi inda za a iya musanya tsarin.
y-m-45-08.prereq.1: Ƙarƙata adadi (maye gurbin x da x−a da y da y−b)
y-m-45-08.prereq.2: Nuna madubi ta layi y=x yana nufin musanya x da y
y-m-45-08.s.s1.prompt: Zaɓi layin farko a warwarewar 지후 da ya yi kuskure.
y-m-45-08.s.s1.hint.0: Zaɓi maki guda a layin da aka matsar, ka koma baya ka ga daga wane maki ne aka motsa shi a layin asali.
y-m-45-08.s.s1.hint.1: Saka maki (0,1) na m cikin ma’aunin sabon layi, ka bincika inda yake idan aka matsar da shi dama da 3. [figures: 0, 1, 3]
y-m-45-08.s.s1.line.0: Don matsar da m da 3 zuwa alkiblar x, saka x+3 maimakon x: y=2(x+3)+1=2x+7.
y-m-45-08.s.s1.line.1: Don nuna madubi na wannan layi ta y=x, musanya x da y: x=2y+7.
y-m-45-08.s.s1.line.2: Warware don y yana ba da y=(x−7)/2.
y-m-45-08.s.s1.line.3: Saboda haka sakamakon yin ㉠ sannan ㉡ shi ne y=(x−7)/2.
y-m-45-08.s.s1.explain: Layi na 1 ya yi kuskure. Idan an matsar da shi dama da 3, maki (x,y) na jadawalin asali yana zuwa (x+3,y), don haka ana samun sabon layi ta saka x−3 maimakon x: y=2(x−3)+1=2x−5. Layukan baya sun yi amfani da ƙimar layi na 1 yadda take. Sakamako daidai shi ne y=(x+5)/2 daga x=2y−5.

Nemo (p,q) daban-daban guda 3 inda maki da aka samu ta matsar da (1,3) da (p,q) sannan nuna madubi ta y=x ya zama iri ɗaya da maki da aka samu ta fara nuna madubi ta y=x sannan matsar da (p,q). Don maki biyun su yi daidai, 3+q=3+p da 1+p=1+q, saboda haka p=q. Misalai: (1,1), (2,2), (−3,−3). [figures: 1, 3, 3, 1, 3, 1, 3, 1, 3, 3, 1, 1, 1, 1, 2, 2, 3, 3]

y-m-45-08.s.s3.hint.0: Raba yanayin p=q da p≠q, kwatanta ko maki guda a jadawali yana zuwa wuri ɗaya a tsare-tsaren biyun.

y-m-45-08.s.s3.r.a: Idan sakamakon matsar maki iri ɗaya ne, jadawalai ma iri ɗaya ne. Idan p≠q, bisa jadawali suna iya zama iri ɗaya.
y-m-45-08.s.s3.o.b: Idan ana nuna madubi ta y=x, musanya tsari da matsarwa kullum yana ba da sakamako iri ɗaya.

y-m-45-08.s.s3.o.c: Da zarar an kayyade alkiblar matsarwa, musanya tsari ba ya canja komai.
y-m-45-08.s.s3.r.c: Sanin alkibla ba ya sa sakamakon ya zama iri ɗaya. Dole a duba dangantakar nisan p da q.
y-m-45-08.s.s3.o.d: Idan p≠q, sakamakon musanya tsari kullum daban ne ko wane jadawali ne aka matsar.
y-m-45-08.s.s3.r.d: Bisa jadawali, sakamako na iya zama iri ɗaya. Matsar da layin y=−x+c ta tsare-tsaren biyun.
y-m-45-08.s.s3.explain: Idan p=q, sakamakon tsare-tsaren biyun iri ɗaya ne a kowane maki, saboda haka jadawalai ma iri ɗaya ne. Idan p≠q, yawanci daban ne, amma akwai keɓancewa: layin y=−x+c ya zama layi ɗaya y=−x+c+p+q ko wane tsari aka matsar da shi.
